verdict.rationale: Greptile documents its own batch actions over review findings. The "Fix All" button sends every issue in a review to a coding agent at once, the MCP `/check-pr` command fixes all review comments on a PR, and `greptile review --agent` outputs every catch with suggested fixes for an agent to apply. Each of these is limited to the comments of a single PR, so broader bulk operations are not shown. Missing for 10: bulk actions across many PRs or repositories, bulk resolve/dismiss or settings changes at scale, any bulk API endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of Fix All or /check-pr.
